errors.text_span: в рамките на периода от януари 2024 до април 2024 г.
errors.evidence: The description states the period is from January to April 2024, but the x-axis clearly shows dates only within March 2024 (from 3/1/2024 to 3/15/2024).
The description misreads the end date on the x-axis as 15/4/2024 (April 15th), when it is actually 3/15/2024 (March 15th).
The dates on the x-axis are arranged chronologically, not in alphabetical order.
The description refers to a non-existent date '37/5/2024'. This appears to be a misreading of the date with the highest value, which is 3/7/2024.
The description states the highest bar reaches approximately 8.00 l/m², but the chart shows this bar is well above 10.00, at approximately 10.8 l/m².
The description incorrectly identifies the bars for 3/1/2024 and 3/3/2024 as the lowest. The lowest bars are at a value of 0 on several other dates (e.g., 3/4/2024, 3/5/2024, 3/8/2024).
The description claims the bars for 3/1/2024 and 3/3/2024 reach a height of about 2.00 l/m². In the chart, the bar for 3/1/2024 is over 3.00, and the bar for 3/3/2024 is very close to 0.
